title: In sixth grade, he studied hard for a math contest to win a trip to Disney World. He barely came fourth.
caption:
In sixth grade, he studied hard for a math contest to win a trip to Disney World. He barely came fourth.

At 17 he left New Mexico to code in Silicon Valley. At 19 he co-founded Scale AI and told his parents it was just for the summer.

He spent his 19th birthday with fellow interns, including future founders of Cognition, Hyperliquid and Decagon.

That kid is Alexandr Wang, Meta's chief AI officer.

Who's in your old birthday photos?
